mapper.select:
SELECT pi."name" as productName, COALESCE(pi.spu_no, '') as spuNo, regexp_split_to_table(pt.charge_name,',') as chargeName, sum(case when plan_start_time is not null and plan_end_time is not null then date_part('day', pt.plan_end_time + '1 day' - pt.plan_start_time) ELSE '0' END) as planTaskTime, sum(case when pttr.reality_end_time is not null and pttr.reality_start_time is not null then date_part('day', pttr.reality_end_time +'1 day' - pttr.reality_start_time) ELSE '0' END) as consumerTime, count(case when plan_start_time is not null and plan_end_time is not null then 1 else 0 END) as planTaskNum, count(pt."id") as totalTaskNum, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.status = 4 THEN 1 else 0 end) finishedTaskNum, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.status != 4 THEN 1 else 0 end) unfinishedTaskNum, SUM(CASE WHEN (pt.status = 0 OR pt.status = 1 OR pt.status = 2 OR pt.status = 3) and pt.plan_end_time is not null and pt.plan_end_time < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 else 0 end) delayTaskNum FROM "project_task" pt LEFT JOIN product_info pi on pt.product_id = pi.id LEFT JOIN project_task_time_record pttr on pt.id = pttr.project_task_id
and (pi."name" like concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword} ,'%') or pi.spu_no like concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword} ,'%'))
and pttr.reality_end_time >= #{params.startDate} and pttr.reality_end_time <= #{params.endDate}
and
#{item} = ANY (string_to_array(pt.charge_id,','))
${param}
GROUP BY pi."name", chargeName,spuNo ORDER BY pi.create_time DESC
